subject: Fix typos in comments and rename TimedOut/Sparkline functions and tests (#2252)
reason: The change only renames internal C functions (migrateCloseTimedoutSockets, latencyCommandGenSparkeline, scriptIsTimedout, sentinelKillTimedoutScripts) with all call sites updated, fixes typos in comments and TCL test names, and changes a reply string solely in the hello* example modules, which are sample code not loaded by the server. No command reply, data structure, replication, cluster or persistence behaviour of the server changes, so there is no path a scenario could differentiate between the two builds.
